title: SG-2.2 · Validated object and world content schema
summary: Validated object/world content schema with the-boys-room moved to src/content/worlds
description: Context: game/src has a manifest zod schema but object and world content is loaded without a runtime schema, and the-boys-room lives in game/content/worlds. Desired behavior: a zod object/world schema covering position, scale, layer, interaction bounds, actions, visibility conditions and persistent-state fields, with the-boys-room content adapted to it under game/src/content/worlds/the-boys-room. Expected result: loadWorld returns schema-validated content from the new location. Why: future AI cycles add objects through content only.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object with position, scale, layer, interactionBounds, actions, visibleWhen and persistentState, when parsed by the schema, then it succeeds
Given invalid object content, when parsed, then a path-named error is returned without throwing
Given the-boys-room under src/content/worlds, when loadWorld runs, then it loads and passes validateWorld

in_scope: scene view visibility and persistent state

technical_constraints: zod already a dependency of game/
definition_of_done: All three requirements verified by unit tests
